features.name: Freeze disabled inbound daily traffic
features.description: Keep traffic recorded before an inbound is disabled while preventing later stale counter changes from being attributed to that node.
done_criteria: Traffic accumulated before an inbound is disabled remains in today's totals.
Counter changes reported after an inbound is disabled do not increase today's totals.
Enabled inbound traffic continues to be aggregated.
The dashboard reflects the corrected daily node traffic without browser errors.
verification: 2026-09-05: npm run check, npm run verify:fast, and git diff --check passed.
2026-09-05: Regression coverage confirmed traffic accumulated while enabled remains frozen after the inbound is disabled, even if its stale API counter later increases.
2026-09-05: Browser verification confirmed the dashboard remained healthy with no console or page errors.

interactions: Logged in as administrator and opened the dashboard.
Confirmed today's node traffic card rendered after the corrected freeze semantics were applied.
